portInfo.description: Genoa (Genova) is a major Ligurian cruise and ferry hub. Cruise ships typically use the historic Stazioni Marittime area (Ponte dei Mille / nearby piers) within walking distance of the Porto Antico waterfront aquarium district and the steep medieval centro storico.
portInfo.location: Liguria, northwest Italy, on the Ligurian Sea

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Most cruise calls use Stazioni Marittime facilities at Ponte dei Mille or Ponte Andrea Doria—check your cruise documents for the assigned terminal
gettingThere.distanceToCity: Passenger terminals sit beside Porto Antico; historic center is typically within about 0.5–1.5 km depending on berth and route
gettingThere.walkingTime: Often 5–20 minutes to aquarium/waterfront; longer uphill into historic lanes—confirm on your sailing programme before you rely on a fixed walk time.
gettingThere.taxiInfo: Taxis available for hill neighborhoods, Nervi, or Cinque Terre connections when time allows
gettingThere.publicTransport: On foot: the city centre is a few hundred metres away. Allow about 15 min to the Porto Antico and Aquarium (estimate). Metro and rail: metro stops are nearby, and Genova Piazza Principe station is about 500 m away. Regional trains toward La Spezia/Cinque Terre exist in principle; no dated Trenitalia sample is cited here — do not plan Cinque Terre independently from this guide. Airport: 5 km.
gettingThere.distanceAnswer: Passenger terminals sit beside Porto Antico; historic center is typically within about 0.5–1.5 km depending on berth and route

thingsToDo.intro: Genoa’s Stazioni Marittime berths put Porto Antico and the steep centro storico within walking range—comfortable shoes matter as much as the itinerary.
topThings: Via Garibaldi and the Palazzi dei Rolli, Renaissance palaces. 75 min.
Caruggi of the old town (editorial). 60 min.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Confirm Ponte dei Mille vs Ponte Andrea Doria on your documents. Both sit by the passenger complex, but walking routes differ slightly.
